correctness.rationale: Zonotope volume is the sum of absolute 4x4 maximal minors. Since scaled h occurs at most once in each minor, the base volume a and the one-/two-direction increments b,c,q are affine in t>=0. For arbitrary s,r defect is sr(aq-bc), and each pair polynomial F=bc-aq has degree at most two. Independently enumerated all 45 unordered pairs of ten elementary vectors with integer permutation determinants at t=0,1. Recovered F(d14,d23)=4t(t-2), all 44 others with nonnegative constant/linear and strictly positive quadratic coefficients, and exactly eight zero constants. This exhausts the finite graph and implies every real t>=0, s,r>0 by polynomial identity.
